name: Roth.roth_rat
source:
theorem roth_rat {α : ℝ} (hα : Irrational α) (halg : IsAlgebraic ℚ α) {κ : ℝ}
    (hinf : {x : ℚ | |α - x| < 1 / (x.den : ℝ) ^ κ}.Infinite) : κ ≤ 2 := by
  refine roth hα halg ((hinf.image (f := fun x : ℚ ↦ (x.num, x.den))
    (fun _ _ _ _ hxy ↦ Rat.ext (congrArg Prod.fst hxy) (congrArg Prod.snd hxy))).mono ?_)
  rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨x.den_pos, by rwa [← Rat.cast_def]⟩

what: The exponent of infinitely many reduced rational approximations to an irrational algebraic real is at most two.
how: Inject rationals into numerator-denominator pairs using Rat.ext and apply roth after identifying values with Rat.cast_def.
hypotheses: Irrational real algebraic number; infinitely many rational approximations measured by their reduced denominator.
